verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has nothing on calendar versus anniversary billing, aligning bill dates across a customer's subscriptions, or setting custom billing anchor or invoice dates. The closest items are adjacent and earn no credit: editing an invoice's due date after it is issued, and controlling when a plan change takes effect. Neither is control of the billing cycle anchor.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can control billing anchors and cycles — calendar vs anniversary billing, alignment across a customer's subscriptions, custom invoice dates
